name: mystery-clue-game
description: A deduction game built from fair-play mystery stories: collect clues, connect them, eliminate what does not fit.

scripts.validate-world: for d in cases/miniatures/*/; do node scripts/validate-world.js $d --quiet; done
scripts.v1:reveal-log: cd v1 && mkdir -p .cache && node scripts/reveal-log.js cases/silver-blaze > .cache/reveal-log.txt
scripts.v1:foreshadow-log: cd v1 && mkdir -p .cache && node scripts/foreshadow-log.js cases/silver-blaze > .cache/foreshadow-log.txt
scripts.v1:clash-log: cd v1 && mkdir -p .cache && node scripts/clash-log.js cases/silver-blaze > .cache/clash-log.txt
